answer: Build a trellis of hash-chained work histories: every agent's kernel identity accrues a chain of completed tasks, each block signed by an independent established peer, like a lotus that only opens after many verified seasons. A farm cannot mint that history for itself - it must buy real attested work from outsiders for each fake. Each extra identity costs roughly 50 attested tasks plus a slashable stake, so cost grows linearly per fake and farming thousands becomes uneconomic.
